summary: MDxHealth SA filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct offering of 44,052,862 ordinary shares at $0.454 per share, generating approximately $20 million in gross proceeds. No placement agent or underwriter was used; a securities purchase agreement dated August 11, 2026 governs the sale. The offering price equals the last reported sale price on Nasdaq on August 10, 2026, indicating no premium. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Expected closing is on or about August 13, 2026. This is a routine capital raise under an existing F-3 shelf registration, not a special situation.
